positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
TrustYou crawls and analyzes online consumer reviews, mostly in the hospitality sector. I was privileged to experience and shape its growth over nearly ten years, from a small startup through its acquisition in 2017, reaching more than 160 employees.

In my role as CTO, I oversaw these areas, together with an excellent leadership team:

Engineering Leadership
- Grew teams from 10 to over 60 engineers in 3 office locations: Munich, Spain, Romania
- Technology leadership for diverse stack, ranging from AI, data science, data engineering to web and mobile app development

Product Management
- Leadership of product management and design teams
- Launch of several successful products, combining data analysis with intuitive UX to deliver valuable insights to our customers
- String of successful projects with enterprise customers and big tech partners

Customer Success
- Since 2017, responsible for customer success teams across our 5 office locations
- Creation of a professional services team to cater to the needs of our largest customers

company.tagline: Enabling organizations to define and achieve their most important goals.
company.description:
Workpath is a strategic planning software company helping organizations turn their most important goals into measurable results.

Our platform enables leadership teams to define strategic priorities, align execution across the organization, and track progress with clarity and accountability.

In addition to our software, we offer advisory and enablement services to support successful strategy deployment and lasting execution discipline.

Our mission: Enabling organizations to define and achieve their most important goals.
